# Vetta 0.6.29
<!-- release-status: unreleased -->

## English

### New

- Eight new plush animal app icons on a black background: corgi, owl, fox, husky, snowy owl, red panda, penguin and kitten. The icon picker in Settings → Appearance is now grouped into Classic, Animals and Pixel.

### Improvements

- Scrolling the Design Resources picker on the canvas and in chats no longer stutters; hovering a card still plays its demo preview after a moment.

### Fixes

- With no model available, such as after Magpie was removed as your only provider, past conversations still open; sending asks you to set up a model first. Thanks to @Tumicc (openvetta/open-vetta#91).
- If a conversation can't be opened, a notice now explains why instead of silently returning to the home page, with a shortcut to model settings when no model is available.
- The Magpie connection notice now warns when Magpie was your only model source, so you know conversations can't continue until you connect it.
- Links in the update notes, and other web links inside the app, open in your system browser instead of replacing the Vetta window with no way back.

## 中文

### 新增

- 新增八款黑底毛绒动物应用图标：柯基、猫头鹰、狐狸、哈士奇、雪鸮、小熊猫、企鹅、小猫。设置 → 外观的图标选择改为按经典、动物、像素分组。

### 改进

- 画布和会话里的「设计资源」选择框滚动不再卡顿，悬停卡片稍后仍会播放 demo 预览。

### 修复

- 没有可用模型时（如唯一的 Magpie 被移除），旧对话仍能打开查看，发消息会提示先配置模型。感谢 @Tumicc（openvetta/open-vetta#91）。
- 对话打不开时会弹出提示说明原因，不再静默退回欢迎页；没有可用模型时提示里可直接去设置模型。
- Magpie 接入提示在 Magpie 是唯一模型来源时会明确说明：接入之前对话无法继续。
- 更新说明里的链接和应用内其他网页链接改用系统浏览器打开，不会再把 Vetta 窗口替换成网页且无法返回。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openvetta/open-vetta/compare/v0.6.28...v0.6.29
